chill.title: Sunset on Cliff Drive in Kessler Park
chill.description: A winding scenic byway along limestone bluffs in the Northeast, with overlooks facing out over the river bottoms.
chill.bonus: Walk out to the Colonnade and watch the lights come on.

chill.title: Pour-Over at Messenger Coffee
chill.description: A three-storey roastery and bakery in the Crossroads, with a big open staircase and a rooftop deck for slow mornings.
chill.bonus: Take your coffee up to the roof.

chill.title: Quiet Hour at Kauffman Memorial Garden
chill.description: A free, walled botanical garden with a conservatory, fountains and formal beds that is rarely busy.
chill.bonus: Find a bench and sit for twenty minutes without your phone.

chill.title: Afternoon at Powell Gardens
chill.description: Kansas City's botanical garden, spread over nearly a thousand acres of rolling countryside, with a stone-and-glass chapel and a big edible garden.
chill.bonus: Find the Marjorie Powell Allen Chapel and sit inside.

chill.title: Fountain Walk on the Country Club Plaza
chill.description: A 1920s Spanish-style shopping district strung with tiled towers and fountains — one of the reasons KC calls itself the City of Fountains.
chill.bonus: Count the fountains; try to find ten.

chill.title: Ride the Streetcar End to End
chill.description: The free KC Streetcar runs from the River Market to Union Station and on to the university, which makes a slow ride the easiest city tour there is.
chill.bonus: Get off at one stop you would normally ride straight past.

foodie.title: Pan-Fried Chicken at Stroud's
foodie.description: Skillet-fried chicken served family-style with cinnamon rolls, mashed potatoes and gravy, at a Kansas City standard going back to 1933.
foodie.bonus: Don't touch the chicken until you've had a cinnamon roll.

foodie.title: Tour Boulevard Brewing Co.
foodie.description: A behind-the-scenes tour of the brewery behind Tank 7 and the Unfiltered Wheat, finishing with a tasting in the rooftop hall.
foodie.bonus: Try something from the Smokestack Series you can't buy at the store.

foodie.title: Late-Night Burger at Town Topic
foodie.description: A tiny counter diner cooking onion-smashed burgers since 1937 — still the best move after midnight.

foodie.title: Saturday at City Market
foodie.description: The River Market's open-air farmers market, surrounded by international grocers and quick-food spots, running on Kansas City weekends since the 1850s.
foodie.bonus: Eat breakfast from a vendor you've never heard of.

foodie.title: The Freight House at Jack Stack
foodie.description: The sit-down end of KC barbecue — crown prime beef ribs and cheesy corn bake in an old rail freight building by Union Station.
foodie.bonus: Order the crown prime beef rib, even if it's the priciest thing on the menu.

foodie.title: Hi, May I Help You at Gates Bar-B-Q
foodie.description: The KC institution where staff shout the famous greeting before you reach the counter — have your order ready.
foodie.bonus: Order without hesitating when they call out to you.

foodie.title: Burnt Ends at Q39
foodie.description: Competition-BBQ pedigree in a sit-down room — burnt ends, brisket and a sausage sampler, with enough sides to feed a table twice over.
foodie.bonus: Order the sampler and argue about the best meat.

adventure.title: Run the Hospital Hill Run
adventure.description: Kansas City's hilly half-marathon, running since 1974, with a course that climbs through midtown and past the Liberty Memorial.
adventure.bonus: Run the hill you dread the most without walking.

adventure.title: Hike Weston Bend, Then Lunch in Weston
adventure.description: Bluff-top trails high over the Missouri River, followed by lunch in a small river town full of old brick buildings and wineries.
adventure.bonus: Climb the scenic overlook tower before you leave the park.

adventure.title: Ride the Indian Creek Trail
adventure.description: A long paved greenway that follows the creek through the southern suburbs, with shade, bridges and barely a road crossing for miles.
adventure.bonus: Ride until you hit the Missouri state line and turn back.

adventure.title: Mountain Bike the Swope Park Trails
adventure.description: Rocky, rooty singletrack cut through the woods of one of the biggest city parks in the country.
adventure.bonus: Ride the whole blue loop without putting a foot down.

adventure.title: Ride the Mamba at Worlds of Fun
adventure.description: A day at Kansas City's big amusement park, anchored by the Mamba — a 200-foot hypercoaster with some serious airtime.
adventure.bonus: Ride in the front row at least once.

adventure.title: Rope Up at RoKC
adventure.description: A big climbing gym in an old industrial building with tall lead walls, auto-belays and a bouldering cave for first-timers and regulars alike.
adventure.bonus: Try one route a grade above your comfort zone.

adventure.title: Indoor Skydive at iFLY
adventure.description: Float on a column of air in a vertical wind tunnel, with an instructor keeping you steady until you figure out how to fly.
adventure.bonus: Pay for the high-fly upgrade and go to the top of the tunnel.

adventure.title: Hike Burr Oak Woods
adventure.description: A conservation area of old-growth oak forest and mossy limestone outcrops, twenty-five minutes from downtown but feeling far further.
adventure.bonus: Find the biggest boulder on the Bethany Falls Trail.

social.title: Royals Game at Kauffman Stadium
social.description: Baseball in one of the prettiest parks in the majors, with a giant crown scoreboard and fountains beyond the outfield wall.
social.bonus: Watch an inning from the fountain terrace.

social.title: Westport Bar Crawl
social.description: Kansas City's oldest neighbourhood is its liveliest nightlife strip — dive bars, patios and live music within a few walkable blocks.
social.bonus: Visit four bars and order a different drink in each.

social.title: KC Current at CPKC Stadium
social.description: The first stadium built for a women's pro team, right on the riverfront, with a crowd that treats every match like a final.
social.bonus: Stand in the supporters' section for the second half.

social.title: Late Jazz Jam at The Blue Room
social.description: A small club inside the American Jazz Museum at 18th & Vine, where the Monday jam session draws players from across the city.

social.title: Night Out at KC Live!
social.description: A covered block in the Power & Light District lined with bars and a big screen, packed on game nights and weekends.
social.bonus: Watch a game there with a crowd of total strangers.

social.title: Show at the Uptown Theater
social.description: A 1928 atmospheric movie palace turned concert hall, with a painted night sky still over the dance floor.
social.bonus: Look up at the ceiling once the lights go down.

social.title: Chiefs Game at Arrowhead
social.description: A tailgate that starts at dawn, then one of the loudest stadiums in the NFL — a full sea of red.
social.bonus: Get to the lot early and eat at a stranger's tailgate.

social.title: Speakeasy Drinks at Swordfish Tom's
social.description: An unmarked basement cocktail bar in the Crossroads with a short list of classics and a doorway you have to go looking for.
social.bonus: Find the entrance without looking it up.

culture.title: Truman Presidential Library
culture.description: A redesigned museum on the presidency that ended World War II and opened the Cold War, plus Truman's grave in the courtyard.
culture.bonus: Try the museum's decision exhibits and say what you would have done.

culture.title: Plaza Lighting Ceremony
culture.description: A Thanksgiving-night tradition since 1930, when the Country Club Plaza's rooftops and towers light up all at once in front of a huge crowd.
culture.bonus: Get there early enough to stand at the front.

culture.title: Jazz at the Folly Theater
culture.description: A restored 1900 burlesque house downtown, now one of the best-sounding rooms in the city for touring jazz.

culture.title: Arabia Steamboat Museum
culture.description: A steamboat that sank in 1856 and was dug out of a Kansas cornfield in 1988, with its whole cargo — boots, dishes and even pickles — on display.
culture.bonus: Ask the lab staff what they are cleaning today.

culture.title: American Jazz Museum
culture.description: Kansas City's jazz history, from Count Basie to Charlie Parker, told in the historic 18th & Vine district where it was played.

culture.title: Nerman Museum of Contemporary Art
culture.description: A free contemporary art museum on a community-college campus that has no business being this good.
culture.bonus: Find the work you like least and figure out why.

culture.title: Kemper Museum of Contemporary Art
culture.description: A free contemporary art museum with a giant steel spider out front and a sharp rotating programme inside.
culture.bonus: Get lunch at the museum's café, Café Sebastienne.

culture.title: Negro Leagues Baseball Museum
culture.description: The story of Black professional baseball told a few blocks from where the Negro National League was founded, ending on a field of bronze players.
culture.bonus: Walk the Field of Legends last.

8ball.title: Order Whatever the Pitmaster Says
8ball.description: Walk into a barbecue joint you have never been to and order exactly what the person at the counter recommends — no menu, no second-guessing.
8ball.bonus: Try a sauce you've never tasted.

8ball.title: Follow a Fountain
8ball.description: Pick a Kansas City fountain on the map you have never seen, go there, and spend the afternoon on whatever is within a ten-minute walk.
8ball.bonus: Eat at the closest place with a line.
